timeline.title: Functional Analyst & Senior Full Stack Developer
points: SIGDI: national document management and technology inventory system. Tracks stock, movements, purchases and the full life cycle of assets (PHP, Laravel, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Docker).
Institutional LMS and wiki with videos, self-assessments and tutorials, so staff can train themselves and find answers fast.
Operations and national logistics platform: planning, technician assignment, travel and per diem requests, and financial viability control for missions in every province.
Digitization and integration of institutional records, with a two-way connection to the asset management platform.
Dedicated servers for development and staging, and deployments on centralized state infrastructure for national use.

timeline.title: Full Stack Developer
points: Cognit: SaaS in production with active monetization. Appointments, patient follow-up, clinical history, reminders and payment control for psychologists, cutting debts and cancellations (React/Vite, Tailwind CSS, Firestore, Vercel).
Radio LD: lightweight audio streaming PWA for low-end phones. Argentine stations with no ads and a simple interface for older adults (JavaScript, Firebase Firestore, Netlify).
